pages.text: $(item)Nebular Ice$(). Water, carbon monoxide and ammonia frozen together at fifteen kelvin. Warmed in an Electrolytic Cell, it gives off Molecular Cloud gas.
$(thing)Found$(): Patches in the Molecular Cloud Nebula, among its clouds.$(br2)$(thing)Used$(): Two sublimate into 250 mB of Molecular Cloud in the Electrolytic Cell.
